real.label: If grace reaches the dealers it has to reach me too
real.note: The list is an argument he's making on his own behalf. Naming everyone else's sin first is how he gets his own name onto the roll without saying it.

real.label: I call on him in the minute before I do it anyway
real.note: The prayer isn't a hinge, it's a companion to the choice. He wants to be accompanied through the wrong turn, not stopped at it.

real.label: Nobody else is rapping about Jesus and that gap is mine
real.note: The thing the radio won't play is also the thing no competitor is doing. Conviction and market positioning arriving in the same bar.
